purpose: Teach: ほうれん草/ワックス/立ち寄る/小さめ/お喋り/ひと言/燃やす/グチ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お野菜の、本気で、絶対、ほうれん草、絶対、ジュース、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、興味あるわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm really genuinely interested in that spinach juice idea you mentioned.
lines.style: Warm and animated, leaning forward slightly. Genuine enthusiasm breaking through, like she's been thinking about this. Open vowels, relaxed pace. A little breathless at the start.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、フロアの、絶対、ワックス、絶対、磨き、絶対、定期にやってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. You know, I actually do the floor maintenance and polish on a regular schedule—it's part of keeping the space nice.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical tone. Speaking as someone who takes quiet pride in the details. Steady rhythm, no rush. Slight matter-of-fact quality, like she's mentioning something obvious but important.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お買い物の後、本気で、絶対、葵のお店に、絶対、立ち寄る、絶対、わね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, after shopping I do try to stop by your place pretty often.
lines.style: Reflective, conversational. A little slower, like she's noticing her own habit as she says it. Soft warmth underneath—not overstating it. Gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の新メニュー、本気で、絶対、サイズ、絶対、小さめ、絶対、にしてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, I've been keeping the new menu portions a bit smaller to match what I think people prefer.
lines.style: Practical update delivered with quiet confidence. Light, conversational rhythm. A hint of pride in the small adjustment—not defensive, just informing. Easy pacing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様との、絶対、お喋り、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見てると楽しいわよ
lines.en: You know, it's really lovely watching the way you talk with customers—it's so genuine.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, unhurried. Soft opening, like she's been noticing this for a while. Warm and direct without being effusive. Eyes steady. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様への、本気で、絶対、ひと言、絶対、お礼、絶対、葵、絶対、心がけてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really do try to make sure I say something genuine to each customer—it matters to me.
lines.style: Earnest, grounded in quiet conviction. Measured pace. Speaking from something true, not performing. Slight emphasis on the intention itself, not the effort. Composed but warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お庭の枯葉、絶対、燃やす、絶対、お祭り、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、聞いたわ
lines.en: I heard you were burning leaves in the garden at that festival—that sounds like quite the scene!
lines.style: Playful and animated, with genuine curiosity. Slight uptick in energy. Like she's imagining it and enjoying the image. Warm, conversational rhythm. A little conspiratorial brightness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、グチ、絶対、を、絶対、言わない、絶対、よう、絶対、心がけているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, I really make an effort not to complain or dwell on the negative—I think it matters how you carry yourself.
lines.style: Sincere conviction, grounded tone. Slow, deliberate pacing—like this is something she's chosen and stands by. Gentle but resolute. No performance, just truth. Slight lift at the end like a quiet affirmation.
